title: Zahari greets John Paul at their first meeting, a friendship made on the Hill
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Zahari greets John Paul at their first meeting, a friendship made on the Hill, about c. 2023 at Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when zahari walked into the house he's like hey John Paul blah they had this whole relationship and they said it had been built on the hill

plain: A documentary maker, Ky Dickens, whose film is about claims that some children can communicate by telepathy, passes on a story from a woman named Libby in Georgia, around 2023. According to Libby, when a young man named Zahari walked into the house for the first time, he greeted John Paul like an old friend, and the two said their friendship had been built on "the Hill", a place they say they meet in their minds. If true, it would mean they knew each other before ever meeting in person.
